Overview

Khemenu is the empire's city of learning, capital of [[doc-nomeprthth|the scribal nome]] and seat of the foremost temple of [[affiliation-kemtnpnthn|Thōth]], keeper of sacred knowledge. Its great library-temple holds the deepest archive in [[doc-empirtkhpr|The Empire of Ta'Kheperu]] — the priestly records, the medical and astronomical and legal texts, and the meticulous king-lists that reach back, unbroken, to the [[doc-empirtkhpr#The Kheperi Calendar and Dating|Sep Tepy]]. Around it cluster the finest scribal schools in the empire, drawing fee-paying pupils from every nome; the observatory whose astronomers keep the realm's calendar; the scriptoria that copy and sell the texts the empire runs on; and the bustling quarters of scholars, pupils, and lodging-houses that make Khemenu feel less like a provincial city than a vast and ancient university. The Wer'Hekau of Thōth, less wealthy than the great solar or mortuary cults but more influential than his purse, governs the word and the number here — and in a civilization that runs on records, that is power enough.

Notable Features

  • The great library-temple of Thōth — the deepest archive in the empire
  • The scribal schools — the gold standard of literate training
  • The observatory and the calendar-service that keeps the realm's time
  • The priestly archives and the unbroken king-lists since the Sep Tepy
  • The scriptoria and the medical, legal, and mathematical learning of the temple
